fields.symptoms:
Low-grade fever
Mild cough
Frequent sneezing
Throat irritation:
fields.advice: Antibiotics are completely ineffective against the common cold because it is caused by viruses (usually rhinoviruses), not bacteria. Taking unnecessary antibiotics will not cure the infection and can lead to unwanted side effects or bacterial resistance
fields.treatment: Use saline nasal sprays or a Neti pot to flush out thick mucus safely
fields.note: The patient has mild upper respiratory viral infection that resolves with rest and symptom-managing medications
